description: This file defines a custom subclass of torch.nn.Linear, called LinearMod, which overrides the forward method to explicitly invoke torch._C._nn.linear. It then traces an instance of this module with a sample input using TorchScript's torch.jit.trace and prints the resulting computation graph.

classes.name: LinearMod
classes.description: A subclass of torch.nn.Linear that overrides the forward method to explicitly call the underlying C extension linear function.

methods.name: __init__(self, *args, **kwargs)
methods.description: Initializes the LinearMod class, passing all arguments to the superclass constructor.

methods.name: forward(self, input)
methods.description: Overrides the forward method to perform a linear transformation using torch._C._nn.linear directly.
